title: VYOMA Innovation Challenge Launched for Offline & Multilingual Voice AI Solutions
summary: DIBD MeitY partners with Current AI and Kalpa Impact to offer up to ₹80 lakh in prizes.

blocks.content: DIBD MeitY partners with Current AI and Kalpa Impact to offer up to ₹80 lakh in prizes.

items: Challenge Mandate: Encourages open-source, voice-first AI solutions operating in low-connectivity environments.
Reference Device: Builds on 'Sunno Sutra', an open-source handheld AI device unveiled at IndiaAI Impact Summit 2026.
Developer Support: 20 shortlisted teams receive developer kits and mentorship.
